name: Allen Kolstad
summary: Allen C. Kolstad (December 24, 1931 – August 2, 2008) was an American politician from Montana.  A Republican from Chester in Liberty County, Montana, he was prominent in state politics for more than 40 years, beginning in 1968 with his election to the state House of Representatives. He served in the  state House and later the Senate for 20 years until he was elected the 25th Lieutenant Governor of Montana on the ticket headed by Stan Stephens in 1988.
